text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Monday:

- Swiss Holocaust Fund president Rolf Bloch said management of the fund would only start when a replacement was found for Elie Wiesel. Wiesel decided on Saturday not to take part in the management of the fund.

- Swiss historian Walther Hofer said the allegation in the recently released Eisenstadt report that Switzerland prolonged World War Two by doing business with the Nazis probably cannot be proved or disproved.
- Swiss small and medium-sized companies see their potential limited or even blocked by state regulations, a recent opinion poll showed.

- Switzerland's rescue unit was not allowed to enter the earthquake region in Iran. Switzerland wanted to send a 99 man strong troup but the foreign ministry in Teheran refused to grant them permission to enter the country.
